LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_UnneededBillToolti: No colonist's assigned loadout currently needs this ammo - the running bill(s) are producing for nobody.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_DeleteAllBillsConf: Delete every ammo production bill on every workbench? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_DeleteAllBillsTool: Remove every ammunition production bill from every workbench.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_PruneConfirm: Delete every ammo bill whose ammo nobody currently assigned needs anymore? Bills still covering real demand are left untouched. This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_PruneTooltip: Bills currently running for ammo that no colonist's assigned loadout demands anymore - production kept going after a loadout was edited/deleted or a colonist reassigned. Bills still covering real demand are never touched.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_AutoGenerateToolti: Goes through every ammo type at once: what is missing gets a bill, and bills nobody needs any more are offered for removal. Nothing changes until you confirm; ammo already in production is left alone.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_WovAvailableWeapon: Only weapons your colony actually owns.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_WovResearchedWeapo: Every weapon whose crafting recipe is researched (whether you own one or not).
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_WovMaterialTip: Material for this bill: {0}. Click to change - the bill is restricted to exactly that material.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_WovCountTip: How many to craft. One click on Produce queues exactly this many - the default is 1.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_MaterialTooltip: Also needs a material (steel, wood, ...), chosen when you produce it.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_WovNotResearchedTo: Can't be produced: its crafting recipe isn't researched yet.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_WovNoBenchTooltip: Can't be produced: no suitable workbench is built on this map.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_DeleteAllWeaponBil: Delete every weapon production bill on every workbench? This cannot be undone.
Remove every weapon production bill from every workbench.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_HiddenWeaponsMessa: {0} selected weapon(s) hidden by the current filter were not produced.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_AmountTooltip: How many rounds one click on a bench adds to the bill. Default: batches x yield ({0} per batch).
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_GenerateAdditiveTo: {0}: add {1} to the ∞ bill (make until). Click again to add more.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_FilterAssignedTip: Only what colonists are actually assigned right now. The shortest list, and the one that matches what your squad will really use.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_FilterActiveBillsT: Only entries that already have a bill queued at a workbench. Use it to review what is being produced.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_AbAvailableWeapons: Ammunition for every weapon the colony owns or can build - wider than the assigned list, so you can stock up before handing the weapons out.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_AbAllAmmunitionTip: Every researched ammunition type, regardless of whether any weapon here uses it. The widest list.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_HideDuplicateBench: With several identical workbenches, show only one of them. Keeps the bench column short; the bill still goes to whichever bench is free.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_NothingMatchesSear: Nothing matches "{0}". Clear the search field to see the full list again.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateAmmoBills_NothingMatchesFilt: The current filter shows nothing. Pick a wider filter above - "{0}" always shows everything researched.
